languages.text: Understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak

text.formatted: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
text.plain: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

text.formatted: The golem makes two attacks, using Slam or Force Bolt in any combination.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +10, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Force damage.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Force damage.

text.formatted: _Ranged Attack Roll:_ +9, range 120 ft. _Hit:_ 22 (4d10) Force damage.
